title: Figure 5. Information Processing Model for a Human Operator
description: Flow diagram linking "Decision Time (sec)" to "Task load ÷ Processing Rate" under an "Intensity" box, with "Task Difficulty" and "Capacity / Resources" connected to "Adaptation" and "Effort," and a box of "States: Fatigue, Motive, Anxiety... etc." that "Modulates" and "Drives" them. A lower relation shows "Decision Time ÷ Time available ⇒ Time pressure" under a "Time" box. Captioned "Figure 5. Information Processing Model for a Human Operator."
